mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost structure for AI SEO services for plastic surgeons?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost structure for AI SEO services for plastic surgeons can vary significantly based on the scope of work, the provider's expertise, and the competitiveness of the market. Most providers offer monthly retainer models, which can range from a few hundred to several thousand dollars per month. Some may offer project-based pricing for specific campaigns or audits. Factors influencing cost include the number of target keywords, the complexity of your website, the intensity of content creation required, and whether local SEO or technical SEO is a primary focus. It's crucial to get a detailed proposal outlining all services included.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for AI SEO services typically involve monthly retainers, ranging from hundreds to thousands of dollars, depending on service scope, market competitiveness, and specific campaign needs.
